Light export: all 13 colour tokens on this board have a semantic-light value (color.action.primary.default, color.action.secondary.default, color.border.subtle, color.env.live, color.surface.app, color.surface.canvas, color.surface.hover, color.surface.raised, color.surface.selected, color.text.link, color.text.primary, color.text.secondary, color.text.tertiary); spacing, sizing and typography have none, as the light theme composes over semantic-dark (E42-D02 L724). In the THEME-WINDOW switch the file's token theme to light, export this same board, and check that nothing renders unresolved (a raw hex or a missing fill).

Compose the board's one PNG: the dark export, with the light export cropped to its two frames under the dark frames (dark row above, light row below); then run docs/design/_tools/cvd_sim.py on it for <stem>-greyscale.png and <stem>-deuteranopia.png (§0 L51-52).

Greyscale gate (AC-4; §0 L77: the tint proof gates the rest of the build): in the greyscale render the rule must read as a line under the band, and '◆ Admin area · Overview' and the h1 'Overview' as words; the band fill is expected to vanish (ΔL* 5.7). If the rule vanishes too, stop and report: D2 fails (Q4).
No inst nodes on this board: every part is a composition (kit deviation 'compose'), so no library set, variant or text layer needs verifying.

deviations: Light pair: Penpot token themes are file-wide, so a light frame cannot sit beside a dark one in one live board. This sheet draws the two dark frames once; the coordinator exports the same board under the light theme in the THEME-WINDOW and composes the dark and light exports into the board's one PNG docs/design/E42/img/E42-D03-09-tint-proof.png: the light export cropped to its two frames and placed under the dark export's, so each row keeps SCR-120 beside SCR-010 and the annotation column shows once (dark). That keeps §0's four frames (L71-72) and its one PNG per board (L50-51, 133 PNGs); placing the light export beside it in the PR instead is the coordinator's other option and adds one PNG to that count. The greyscale and deuteranopia renders (§0 L51-52, L72-73) are made from the composed PNG by docs/design/_tools/cvd_sim.py.

Board name and export: size '1280×800' (§0 L71-72; L48 lists only 08 and 88, a spec gap), theme 'dark+light' (the registry, e42kit BOARDS; §0 L71-72: one live board is the source of both pairs, the theme switch happening at export, as for the light boards, build notes), slug 'tint-proof' (the kit's; L51 takes slugs from the board column of §4–§11, which gives none for 09), and two frames named 'frame-1280 SCR-120 overview' / 'frame-1280 SCR-010 workspace' (the build notes' 'frame-1280', suffixed: cvsheet replaces children by name).
SCR-120 is drawn in OV-2 healthy (L275), the representative state §0 lights for SCR-120 (board 29: L62, L75); it is a target, annotated: today's main reads OV-6 (board 26, L62).

The band's right end is empty: the (b) shell with no grace (SH-6, L186; Q1 L146: '(b) is what the server does'), so the proof rests on no badge; the (a) badge and the (b) grace line are boards 01-05's, and no carrier depends on them (§4 L175-177).
No caption over either frame, on purpose: the proof has to stand on each frame's own carriers in greyscale; the annotation column says which is which (left SCR-120, right SCR-010).

Tiles OV-2 gives no line for (Health, Recorder and storage, Users, Profiles and limits, Flags) show their heading link and their own 'as of' only (L275: 'every tile fresh with its own "as of"'); nothing is invented for them; board 22 owns OV-2's full content.

The Accounts tile's capacity line (D11 L124; §7 L296): text, meter, Change, stacked at 274 px, the tile's inner width (kit choice: SCR-121's one row, the 120 px meter beside the text and its action, does not fit the tile).

The Maintenance line draws §14's tile.maintenance_off, 'Maintenance: off (flags read)' (L603), where OV-2's row abbreviates it 'Maintenance: off' (L275): the line is always the flags read's (§6 L262).
SCR-120 is taller than 1280 x 800, so the frame shows the top of the page and the rest is a page scroll (the fold check under Live checks).

Density (carrier 3, §4 L176) shows on this board inside SCR-120 only: its 32 px Run tamper check is cut by the 704 px fold (686-718 px) and its Audit rows are below the fold (726-822 px). The kit draws the shared chrome (TopBar, NavRail) at 32 px in both frames and SCR-010's content as one canvas placeholder (its controls are E10-D02's, not drawn), so the greyscale comparison rests on carriers 1, 2 and 4 (the words, the rule, the h1), all in view; the Decision ids annotation says SCR-010's density is not drawn.
Board height: the kit's estimate plus 48 px for text-metric error (cap 1760, the page pitch less 40).
Links are colour + position only on the boards: cvsheet v1 texts have no underline.

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

The Audit tile's three CMP-173 compact rows (OV-2 L275, D9 L122) are neutral 32 px placeholder rows (color.surface.hover bars, radius.control): the spec gives no entry data, so no time, actor, action, subject, outcome or severity is invented; board 22 owns OV-2's rows.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
